title.zh: Ocean Compute-to-Data：数据不出域的授权计算
title.en: Ocean Compute-to-Data: authorised compute without moving data

evidence.quote: Instead of selling the raw data itself, you can offer compute access to the private data.
This means you have control over which algorithms can be run on your dataset.
It enables the data to remain on-premise while granting third parties the ability to perform specific compute tasks on it, yielding valuable results like statistical analysis or AI model development.

notes.zh:
交集：用私有数据训练或评测 AI 时，数据持有者常不愿交出原始数据；Compute-to-Data 把授权对象从「数据副本」改成「在数据上运行指定算法」，与 AI 模型开发直接相关。
适用范围：官方文档说不出售原始数据而出售计算访问，数据持有者控制哪些算法可跑，数据可留在本地而第三方执行特定计算任务，产出统计分析或 AI 模型开发结果。本条只写计算授权机制，与 ocean-protocol 概念条的网络与访问控制分工不同。
未解决：算法审核、结果泄露、计算环境可信与法律合规仍要另行核对；文档未给统一部署状态字段，本站不推断隐私或合规保证。
notes.en:
The intersection: when private data is used to train or evaluate AI, holders often do not want to hand over raw data; Compute-to-Data changes the authorised object from a data copy to running approved algorithms on the data, directly relevant to AI model development.
Scope: the official documentation says raw data is not sold; compute access is offered, the holder controls which algorithms may run, and data can remain on-premise while third parties perform specific compute tasks yielding statistical analysis or AI model development. This entry covers the compute-authorisation mechanism, distinct from the ocean-protocol concept entry on network and access control.
Open: algorithm review, result leakage, trusted compute environments and legal compliance still need separate checks; the document gives no single deployment-status field, and this site infers no privacy or compliance guarantee.

specs.协议状态 / status: 官方未说明（机制文档未给协议部署状态字段）
